environment.description: Service deployed in an isolated VPC private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) with no NAT gateway, no internet gateway route, and no VPC endpoints except a single Interface endpoint for CloudWatch Logs (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs). The subnet route table contains only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). An internal NLB with cross-zone disabled forwards TCP/8000 from a peered VPC containing the calling service. The NLB does not preserve or expose response headers to the peered VPC caller — it operates at L4 with TLS passthrough disabled and proxy protocol v2 enabled, meaning the raw HTTP response traverses only the VPC peering connection to the single authorized caller in 10.1.0.0/16. No route exists from 10.0.128.0/20 to 0.0.0.0/0. Security group on ENI allows ingress only from 10.1.4.0/24 (caller subnet) on port 8000.
